<entry id="U01152">
<head-word>שְׁכִינָא</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (שְׁכַן; cmp. שַׁכְבָּנָא) 
<italic>eyelid</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Y. I, II Deut. XXXII, 10 (some ed. שִׁיכְנָא).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="U01153">
<head-word>שְׁכִינָה</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (שָׁכַן) 
<italic>royal residence, royalty</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Lev. R. s. 2 בא ואראך כבודי ובית שְׁכִינָתִי וכ' (not ביתי; some ed. שכונתי) come, and I will show thee my honor and the house of my residence without thy mother; Yalk. Ez. 340 כבודי ובית שבניתי לאמך (corr. acc.). Lev. R. l. c. כלום פיחת כבודי ושכינתי has my honor or my royalty suffered (through thy mother’s absence)?; Yalk. l. c. כבודי או בית שבניתי לכם (corr. acc.).—Esp. 
<italic>Shechinah, Divine Presence, holy inspiration</italic> (v. Ex. XXV, 8, a. 22). Yoma 9
<sup>b</sup> sq. אי נמי סליקו … לא הוה שריא ש' … אין הש' שורה וכ' even if all Jews had returned in Ezra’s days, the Sh. would not have dwelt in the second Temple, for it is written (Gen. IX, 27) …; the Sh. dwells only in the tents of Shem; Gen. R. s. 36. Ber. 6
<sup>a</sup> לשלשה … שש' עמהם that when three sit as judges, the Sh. is with them. Sabb. 12
<sup>b</sup> ש' למעלה וכ' the Sh. dwells over the headside of the sick man’s bed. Ib. 30
<sup>b</sup>; Pes. 117
<sup>a</sup>, v. עֲצֵבוּת. Meg. 29
<sup>a</sup> בכל מקום שגלו ש' עמהן whithersoever they were exiled, the Sh. went with them. B. Bath. 25
<sup>a</sup> ש' בכל מקום the Sh. Is everywhere (you may face any region in prayer). R. Hash. 31
<sup>a</sup>; a. fr. (also in Chald. diction).</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="U01154">
<head-word>שְׁכִינָה</head-word>
<head-word>שְׁכִינתָּא</head-word>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>
<language-reference>same.</language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition />
<notes> Targ. Y. I, II Num. XXIV, 6. Targ. Ex. XVII, 7. Targ. Num. V, 3. Targ. Ez. III, 12; a. fr.—Yoma 9
<sup>b</sup>, v. preced. Snh. 39
<sup>a</sup> אמריתו … ש' שריא כמה שְׁכִינָתָא וכ' you say, wherever ten are assembled (for prayer), there the Sh. dwells; how many Shechinahs are there?; a. fr.—
<plural-form>Pl. שְׁכִינָתָא</plural-form>. Ib.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="U01155">
<head-word>שָׂכִיר</head-word>
<pos> m.</pos>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> שָׂכַר)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>hired man</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Erub. 64
<sup>a</sup>; Shebu. 46
<sup>b</sup> שְׂכִירוֹ וכ', v. לָקִיט h. B. Mets. IX, 11 שְׂ' יום one hired for day work; ש' לילה for night work; ש' שעות by hours; ש' חדש by the month. Ib. 112
<sup>b</sup> (in Chald. dict.) עקרוה … ושדיוה אַשָּׂ' the Rabbis took the oath from the employer, and put it on the hired man. Ib. ש' נמי … איתגר the hired man, too, hires himself out from necessity; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="U01156">
<head-word>שְׂכִירוּת</head-word>
<pos> f.</pos>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (preced.) 
<italic>hire, rent</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Mets. 65
<sup>a</sup>, a. fr. ש' אינה משתלמת וכ' rent (for a house or a field) is not due before the end of the term. Ib. 98
<sup>a</sup> פלגיה דיומא בשאילה … בש' (I let thee have the two cows) half a day as a loan, and half a day for hire. Ib. ודקיימא דש' היא and the cow that survived is the hired one. Ib.
<sup>b</sup>; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="U01157">
<head-word>שָׁכַךְ</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (b. h.) 
<italic>to sink</italic>, (of anger) 
<italic>to be appeased</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ex. R. s. 8 מיד שָׁכָכוּ they (the threatening gates) were at once appeased; (Tanḥ. Vaëra 7 שקטו). Esth. R. to I, 12 עד … לא שָׁכְכָה חמתו וכ' until Esther entered (the palace), Ahasver’s anger was not appeased; a. e.</notes></sense></senses>
<pgbrk id="pg1574" />
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>שִׁכֵּךְ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (with double accus.) 
<italic>to sink a thing into</italic>; ש' אוזן מה שהיא יכולה לשמוע to sink into the ear that which it is able to hear, i.e. 
<italic>to assist a person’s perception</italic> by gradual increase of sound, by a comparison &c. Mekh. Yithro, Bahod.</definition>
<notes>, s. 3; 4 (ref. to Ex. XIX, 19) ולמה רך מתחלה כדי לְשַׁכֵּךְ וכ' (not כך) why was the sound soft at first (growing gradually stronger)? In order to bring into the ear as much &c.; ib. (ref. to Ex. l. c. 18) ומה תלמוד לומר כבשן לשכך וכ' why does the text say, ‘like the smoke of a furnace’? In order to assist the perception &c.; ib. (ref. to Ez. XLIII, 2) הרי … מבריותיו לש' האזן we describe God by borrowing a metaphor from one of his creations in order to &c.; Tanḥ. Yithro 13; Yalk. Ex. 284.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="U01158">
<head-word>שָׂכַל</head-word>
<hw-number>I</hw-number>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> v. 
<xref rid="O00909">סָכַל I</xref>) 
<italic>to be bright</italic>.</definition>
<notes /></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִשְׂכִּיל</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be wise, understand; to consider, deliberate</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Midr. Prov. to I, 3 כיון … צריך להַשְׂכִּיל היאך וכ' when a man is appointed judge, he must deliberate how to acquit the innocent &c.; צריך להשכיל ולדקדק וכ' he must study and investigate the law, that he may not sin or lead to sin; Yalk. ib. 929 צריך להשכיל היאך לדקדק וכ' he must deliberate how to carry out the law exactly &c. Midr. Till. to Ps. XXXII (ref. to I Sam. XVIII, 14, sq.) ומפני שהיה מַשְׂכִּיל היה כסוי חטאה and because he was wise, his sin was covered; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to look towards, face</italic>; (cmp. סָכַם, a. כּוּן) 
<italic>to be directed</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Num. R. s. 14
<sup>5</sup>; Pesik. R. s. 3 (ref. to שִׂכֵּל את ידיו, Gen. XLVIII, 14) הִשְׂכִּילוּ ידיו … לרוח הקדש Jacob’s hands were directed towards (pointed to) the holy spirit.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="U01159">
<head-word>שָׂכַל</head-word>
<hw-number>II</hw-number>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="O00910"> cmp. סָכַל II)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>

<italic>to entangle, cross</italic>.</definition>
<notes /></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>שִׂכֵּל</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> same, trnsf. 
<italic>to cause confusion</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Pesik. R. s. 3 (ref. to Gen. XLVIII, 14) [read:] מהו ש' אמר ר' יהודה ש' ידיו … בבכורתו וכ' (אמר רבי ש', a dittography) he (God) made Jacob’s hands bring confusion into Menasseh’s birthright.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="U01160">
<head-word>שָׁכַל</head-word>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="K00530"> Shafel of כל</xref>,
<xref rid="A00083"> אכל)</xref></language-reference>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> [
<italic>to finish, consume</italic>,] 
<italic>to bereave</italic> (of everything), 
<italic>make childless</italic>; שָׁכֹל 
<italic>to be childless</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Part. pass. שָׁכוּל; f. שְׁכוּלָה; 
<plural-form>pl. f. שְׁכוּלוֹת</plural-form>. Pirké d’R. El. ch. XLIX (v. I Sam. XV, 33) כשם ששִׁכְּלָה … וישבו נשיהם ש' ואלמנות כן תִּשְׁכַּל וכ' as the sword of Amalek, thy (Haman’s) grandfather, consumed the young men …, and their women remained childless and widowed, so shall thy mother be childless among women; ובתפלת … ש' וכ' and through the prayer of Esther and her maids all males of Amalek were killed, and their women remained childless &c.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>שִׁכֵּל</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to destroy, consume</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ib., v. supra. Num. R. s. 16
<sup>24</sup> בראתי אותך שתהא מְשַׁכֵּל באומות וכ' I have created thee (the angel of death) to work destruction among the nations, except &c. Gen. R. s. 86 דוב שהיתה מְשַׁכֶּלֶת בבני אדוניה a bear that worked destruction among the children of her owner; a. e.—Part. pass. מְשׁוּכָּל. Yalk. Cant. 988 (ref. to שכלה, Cant. IV, 2) כל מי שלומד מהם אינו מש' whoever learns from them (the scholars), shall not be bereft (injured).</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="U01166">
<head-word>שִׁכְלֵל</head-word>
<head-word>שִׁיכְ'</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (Shaf. of כלל, cmp. שָׁכַל) 
<italic>to finish, decorate</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Snh. 38
<sup>a</sup> למלך שבנה פלטרין גדולים ושִׁיכְלְלָן וכ' Ms. M. (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) like a king who built great palaces and decorated them, and made arrangements therein for a large banquet &c. Pesik. R. s. 2 אין אתה מְשַׁכְלְלוֹ thou shalt not finish it (the Temple), opp. מיסדו laying the foundation; Yalk. Sam. 144; a. e.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִשְׁתַּכְלֵל, </binyan-form>
<binyan-name>Nithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִשְׁתַּכְלֵל</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be finished, decorated</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Gen. R. s. 10 (ref. to ויכלו, Gen. II, 1) נִשְׁתּכְלְלוּ השמים בחמה … ונִשְׁתַּכְלְלָה הארץ וכ' the heavens were decorated with sun, moon, and stars, and the earth with trees and herbs, and with the garden of Eden; Yalk. ib. 15 נִתְכַּלְּלוּ … ונִתְכַּלְּלָה.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to be founded</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tanḥ. K’doshim 10 (ref. to מכלל, Ps. L, 2) מציון נש' כל וכ' from Zion was the whole world founded, as we have learned (Y. Yoma V, 42
<sup>c</sup>), why is it called foundation stone? &c., v. שְׁתִיָּה II.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="U01169">
<head-word>שָׁכַם</head-word>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, 
<italic>Hif.</italic> הִשְׁכִּים 
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> denom. of שְׁכֶם)</xref></language-reference> [
<italic>to load</italic>, v. Ges. Thes. s. v.,] 
<italic>to rise early; to do a thing early</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ber. 30
<sup>a</sup> ה' לצאת לדרך if one rises early (before sunrise) to go on the road; Tosef. ib. III, 19. Cant. R. to V, 11 (play on שחרות כעורב, ib.; cmp. שׁחַר) מַשְׁכִּים ומעריב (Lev. R. s. 19 משחיר), v. עָרַב II. B. Mets. VII, 1 if one hired working men, ואמר להן להַשְׁכִּים וכ' and told them that he expected them to come to their work earlier and go later (than the customary time). Ber. 47
<sup>b</sup> לעולם יַשְׁכִּים אדם וכ' a man should always go early to the house of prayer, that he may succeed in being counted among the earliest ten &c. Ib. 16
<sup>b</sup>; Y. ib. IV, 7
<sup>d</sup> bot. ונַשְׁכִּים ונמצא וכ' that we may early (in life) obtain &c., v. יִחוּל. B. Kam. 92
<sup>b</sup> הַשְׁכֵּם ואכול take an early breakfast. Gitt. 7
<sup>a</sup> הַשְׁכֵּם והערב עליהן והם וכ' (omit לבה"מ) pray against them (the tormentors) early and late, and they shall cease of themselves; a. fr.—Bicc. III, 2 ולִמַשְׁכִּים היה וכ' and 
<italic>at rising time</italic> &c.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<entry id="U01173">
<head-word>שָׁכַן</head-word>
<language-key>(b. h.;</language-key>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> v. 
<xref rid="K00296">כון</xref>,
<language-reference>
<xref rid="A00083"> כנן)</xref></language-reference>
<italic>to dwell, rest</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Ḥull. 65
<sup>a</sup> ש' עם הטמאים טמא a bird (of which you do not know whether it is clean or unclean) that nests with unclean birds, is unclean. B. Kam. 92
<sup>b</sup> (quot. from an unknown writing, v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 7) כל עוף למינו יִשְׁכֹּון וכ' every bird nests with its kind, and man with his like; Yalk. Gen. 116; Yalk. Jud. 67. Tanḥ. <plural-form>Pl. שְׁכֵינוֹת</plural-form>. Keth. l. c. משיאה … בשְׁכֵיניֹתֶיהָ he is the cause of her bearing a bad name among her neighbors; a. e.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to hire, engage; to rent</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Mets. VI, 1 השׂוֹכֵר את וכ' if one engages artisans (through an agent). Ib. VIII, 2 שאלה … ושְׂכָרָהּ וכ' if he borrowed the cow for half a day, and hired her for half a day. Tosef. ib. IX, 1, sq. השׂוֹכֵר שדה if one rents a field; a. v. fr.—שׂוֹכֵר 
<italic>hirer, employer; tenant</italic>. B. Mets. 103
<sup>a</sup> ש' מהימן בשבועה the employer is believed on his oath (that he has paid the wages). Ib. 102
<sup>b</sup> כוליה לש' the whole (rent for the thirteenth month of the leap year) goes to the tenant, i.e. he need not pay extra rent for the intercalated month; a. v. fr.—Esp. שוכר 
<italic>tenant of land for rent payable in money</italic>, contrad. to חכיר. Tosef. Dem. VI, 2 ש' במעות 
<pgbrk id="pg1576" />וכ' the 
<italic>sokher</italic> pays the rent in cash, the 
<italic>ḥakkir</italic> (or 
<italic>ḥokher</italic>) in kind; a. fr.—Part. pass. שָׂכוּר; f. שְׂכוּרָה. B. Mets. VIII, 2 if the hirer says, ש' מתה it is the hired cow that died; ביום שהיתה ש' מתה she died on the day when I used her for hire; בשעה … ש' וכ' she died at that time of the day when I used her for hire; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִשְׂכִּיר</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to lease, let</italic>.</definition>
<notes> B. Bath. 110
<sup>a</sup> לעולם יַשְׂכִּיר אדם את עצמו וכ' a man should hire himself out for &c., v. עֲבוֹרָה. B. Mets. VIII, 7 המַשְׂכִּיר … המשכיר וכ' if one lets a house …, the landlord has to furnish &c. Ib. 8 ה' לו להדשים … למשכיר if he let the house by the month, … the landlord has the benefit of the intercalated month, v. עָבַר. Pes. 4
<sup>a</sup> על המ' לבדוק the landlord is obliged to search the house for leavened matter; a. fr.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (denom. of שָׂכָר) 
<italic>to cause to profit, to benefit</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tanḥ. ed. Bub., Vayesheb 13 צריך … משכיר אותו (not משביר) a man must pray for the welfare of him that benefits him.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Nif.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִשְׂכַּר</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> (denom. of שָׂכָר) 
<italic>to be rewarded, benefited; to have the advantage</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Yeb. 92
<sup>b</sup> אם כן מצינו חוטא נִשְׂכָּר if this be the law, then he that sinned would be at an advantage; Keth. 11
<sup>a</sup>, a. e. שלא יהא חוטא נ' it is done in order that the sinner should not be at an advantage. Pes. 50
<sup>b</sup>; Tosef. Yeb. IV, 8, v. זָרִיז; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִשְׂתַּכּר, </binyan-form>
<binyan-name>Nithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִשְׂתַּכֵּר</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to profit; to deal in</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Tanḥ. l. c. לפי … מִשְׂתַּכֵּר מצאנו וכ' because Jacob was benefited by his flock &c. Pesik. R. s. 40 ונִשְׂתַּכַּרְתִּי, v. נָצַח. Pes. l. c. המשתכר בקנים וכ' he that deals in reeds and vessels. Ib. 54
<sup>b</sup> ואין אדם יודע במה משתכר and no man knows which of his enterprises will turn out profitable; Mekh. B’shall., Vayass‘a, s. 5. B. Bath. 91
<sup>a</sup> אין מִשְׂתַּכְּרִין בא"י וכ' in Palestine you must not be a dealer in provisions, as wine &c. (serve as middleman between producer and consumer); Tosef. Ab. Zar. IV (V), 1; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<number>1)</number>

R. s. 45 בש' שלש זכה לשלש on account of three things he (Moses) was granted three things; בש' ויסתר וכ' on account of ‘he hid his face’ (Ex. III, 6) &c.; a. fr.—[Yalk. <notes> Lev. R. s. 9 גדול ש' … חותמין בש' peace is something great, for all benedictions, good tidings, and consolations … close with peace. Num. R. s. 21, beg. אין כלי … אלא ש' no vessel contains blessing but peace; Ukts. III, 12, a. e., v. חָזַק. Ber. 14
<sup>a</sup> משיב ש' וכ' may return a salutation to any person. Ib. כל הנותן ש' וכ' he who offers salutation to his neighbor before prayer, is considered as if he made him a highplace (worshipping man before God). Shebi. IV, 3 ושואלין בשְׁלוֹמָן מפני דרכי ש' and you must salute them (gentiles in the field) &c., v. דֶּרֶךְ; Y. ib. 35
<sup>b</sup> מהו שואלין בשלומן בשְׁלוֹם ישראל ש' עליכם how must we salute them? As we salute Israelites, ‘peace be upon you.’ Tam. I, 3 הגיעו … אמרו ש' הכל ש' when they (the two parties patrolling the Temple) met, they said, ‘peace?’ (answer) ‘all peace’ (everything is in good order); Lev. R. l. c. Sifra Vayikra, Par. 13, ch. XVI מי שהוא ש' וכ' he who is at peace offers peace-offerings, opp. אונן; v. שָׁלֵם. Ib. the peace-offerings are called 
<italic>sh’lamim</italic>, שהכל ש' בהן because everything in them is at peace (is turned to use; Yalk. Lev. 458 מְשׁוּלָּמִים). Ber. 39
<sup>b</sup> (play on the name שלמן) ש' אתה וכ' thou art peace (perfection), and thy teaching is perfect (v. שָׁלֵם); a. v. fr.—חס וש', v. חַס.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition> (adv.) 
<italic>safely, unimpaired</italic>.</definition>
<notes> T’bul Yom IV, 7, a. e. שתעלה ש' that it will be brought up safely, v. שֶׁבֶר I.—
<plural-form>Pl. שְׁלוֹמוֹת</plural-form>. Num. R. s. 13
<sup>16</sup> עושה שני ש' וכ' produces two conditions of peace, peace above and peace below. Yalk. Is. 340 ארבעה רוב ש' וכ' (not שלומית) four times in the Scriptures ‘peace’ appears in connection with ‘abundance.’—Ch. v. שְׁלָמָא.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to draw out; to stretch forth; </italic>
<pgbrk id="pg1580" />
<italic>to send</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Erub. III, 2 השׁוֹלֵחַ ערובו וכ' if one sends his ‘Erub (עֵרוּב) forth to be laid by a deaf and dumb person. Ḥull. 59
<sup>b</sup>, a. fr. שָׁלְחוּ מתם they sent word from there (from Palestine to Babylonia). Gitt. IV, 1 השולח גט וכ' if a man sends a letter of divorce to his wife &c. B. Kam. VI, 4, v. בְּעֵרָה. Ib. ש' ביד פיקח (ib. 60
<sup>a</sup> שִׁילֵּחַ) if he sent out fire through a sane person; a. fr.—Part. pass. שָׁלוּחַ q. v.—ש' יד ב־ [
<italic>to stretch out a hand against,</italic>] 
<italic>to make illegitimate use of, to misappropriate</italic> (Ex. XXII, 10). B. Mets. III, 12 השולח יד בפקדון if a person makes use of a trust. Ib. החושב לִשְׁלוֹחַ יד וכ' if he declares his intention to use a trust; אינו חייב עד שיִשְׁלַח בו יד he is not responsible (for loss), until he has used it; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Pi.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>שִׁלֵּחַ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition> same, 
<italic>to send; to send away, dismiss</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Bets. I, 9 אין מְשַׁלְּחִין בי"ט וכ' on the Holy Day you dare not send (to a friend) anything except portions (of eatables, ready for use); משלחין בהמה וכ' you may send cattle … alive or slaughtered. Ḥull. XII, 3 שִׁלְּחָהּ וחזרה if he sent the mother bird away, and she came back. Ib. אמר … ומְשַׁלֵּחַ הבנים if he says, I will take the mother, and send the young away; חייב לשַׁלֵּחַ he is bound to send her away. Gen. R. s. 21 שִׁלְּחוֹ מגן … ושלחו וכ' he banished him (Adam) from the paradise of this world and from that of the other world; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan>
<binyan>
<binyan-name>Hithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>הִשְׁתַּלֵּחַ, </binyan-form>
<binyan-name>Nithpa.</binyan-name>
<binyan-form>נִשְׁתַּלֵּחַ</binyan-form>
<senses>
<sense>
<definition>
<italic>to be sent off; to be commissioned</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Yoma VI, 2, a. e. המִשְׁתַּלֵּחַ the goat that is to be sent away (Lev. XVI, 10), the scapegoat. Ib. 1 נשפך … המשתלח if the blood (of the goat designated for sacrifice) was spilt, the scapegoat is to be put to death (cannot be used for the ceremony). Gen. R. s. 49 מעשה באחד שנש' לגבות וכ' it happened that one was commissioned to tax the inhabitants &c.; a. fr.</notes></sense></senses></binyan></entry>

<entry id="U01266">
<head-word>שְׁלַח</head-word>
<language-key> ch. </language-key>

<senses>
<sense>
<definition>, </definition>
<notes /></sense>
<sense>
<number>1)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to send, send off</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Targ. Num. XIII, 2. Targ. O. ib. 16. Targ. Ps. XLIV, 3 Ms. (ed. פסד'). Targ. Jer. XLII, 6 שָׁלְחִין (not שולחין); a. fr.—Part. pass. שְׁלִיחַ; f. שְׁלִיחָא; 
<plural-form>pl. שְׁלִיחִין, שְׁלִיחָן</plural-form>. Ob. 1. Targ. Is. XLIV, 26 שְׁלִיחוֹהִי ed. Lag. (ed. Wil. שְׁלוּח'). Targ. I Chr. XIV, 15; a. fr.—Ber. 28
<sup>a</sup> ש' להו וכ' R. J. sent them word to the school house; a. fr.—Koh. R. to III, 2 שְׁלִיחְהוֹן דברייתא the messenger of men (men’s guardian angel).</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>
<definition>
<italic>to throw off, undress, flay</italic> (cmp. פָּשַׁט).</definition>
<notes> Targ. Esth. V, 14. Targ. Is. XXXII, 11. Targ. II Chr. XXIX, 34; a. fr.—Ber. l. c. שְׁלַח מדך take off thy cloak (v. מַדָּא). Y. Taan. III, end, 67
<sup>a</sup> הוה ש' מסאניה he took off one shoe; כד הוה ש' תריהון when he had taken off both of them; a. fr.—Part. pass. as ab. Sot. 8
<sup>b</sup> (proverbial expression) ש' ערטילאי וכ' undressed, naked, but with shoes on (a person cares more for shoes than for any other article of dress); Keth. 65
<sup>b</sup> top האי תנא ש' וכ' this Tannai (who gave the wife the right to ask for three pairs of shoes and one suit of clothes) seems to assume that a woman cares more for shoes &c. Koh. R. to V, 10 איך אינון אתיין שליחין וכ' (not שלו') how will they come (on resurrection day), naked, or dressed? Ib. היך זרעתין ש' וכ' how didst thou plant them (the beans), undressed or dressed (in the pods)? a. e.</notes></sense></senses>

<binyan-name>Pa.</binyan-name>

<sup>b</sup>. Sabb. 33
<sup>b</sup> הוו מְשַׁלְּחֵי מנייהו used to put off their clothes. Shebu. 41

<italic>to be stripped; to shed the skin</italic>.</definition>

<italic>to rule, have power over</italic>.</definition>
<notes> Y. Ter. VIII, 45
<sup>d</sup> top כאן האור שׁוֹלֵט וכ' here (in the case of bread) the fire comes in direct contact with it (and kills the poison of the serpent), there (in the case of water that has been warmed) the fire does not &c. Y. Maasr. I, 49
<sup>b</sup> top כאן היד שׁוֹלֶטֶת וכ' here (in the case of a vessel into which a boiling dish has been put) the hand can handle it; there (in the case of a vessel taken directly from the fire) the hand cannot handle it; כאן וכאן אין היד שולטת בו in both cases the dish may be too hot for the hand to handle it; Y. Sabb. III, 6
<sup>b</sup> top. Ib. במקום שהיד שולטת in a place (in the stove) which the hand can get at (to handle the dish placed there); ib. 5
<sup>c</sup> מפני שהוא שַׁלִּיט במקום שהיד שולטת because he keeps control (to regulate the temperature of the dish) there where the handling is possible. Y. B. Mets. X, beg. 12
<sup>c</sup> ששולטת היד מצר אחד that the hand can reach it from one side. Ḥull. 16
<sup>b</sup>; Sabb. 82
<sup>a</sup> דבר שהאור שולטת בו a thing over which fire has power (which is combustible). Ib. רוח רעה שולטת בו an evil spirit (smell of the mouth) will seize him; רוח זוהמא ש' בו (v. Rabb. D. S. a. l. note 30) the spirit of 
<italic>zohăma</italic> (internal decay) will seize him. Gen. R. s. 45) שָׁלְטוּ בעצמן they controlled themselves (interrupted their gratification). Y. Ber. IX, 13
<sup>b</sup> top שולט באיפרכיא וכ' if he rules over one province, he does not rule over another province. Gen. R. s. 3 ביום אני שולט I want to rule (have the guard) in day time; (Y. Ber. VIII, 12
<sup>c</sup> top משמש). Pesik. R. s. 31 אתם שְׁלַטְתֶּם בעצמיכם וכ' (not באצבעותיכם) you had power over yourselves and cut your fingers off; a. v. fr.</notes></sense></senses>

<sup>b</sup>; a. e.</notes></sense>
<sense>
<number>—2)</number>

<italic>message, agency, commission</italic>.</definition>

<sup>b</sup> מוסיף על שליחותו if the agent adds an act of his own to that for which he was commissioned. Lev. R. s. 22 אם אין … שְׁלִיחוּתִי וכ' if you (prophets) do not convey my message, I have (other) messengers. Gen. R. s. 50 (ref. to Gen. XVIII, 2, a. <plural-form>Pl. שְׁלִיחוֹת</plural-form> (fr. שְׁלִיחָה). Ib.; Yalk. ib. 84; Yalk. Job 908 אין … שתי ש' one angel never carries two messages.</notes></sense></senses></entry>

<sup>d</sup> sq. Y. Shebi. V, beg. 35
